description: When the group does not exist in GitLab, it is created.

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: auto_devops_enabled
parameters.description: Default to Auto DevOps pipeline for all projects within this group. Choices: false true

parameters.name: avatar_path
parameters.description: Absolute path image to configure avatar. File size should not exceed 200 kb. This option is only used on creation, not for updates.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: default_branch
parameters.description: All merge requests and commits are made against this branch unless you specify a different one.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A description for the group.

parameters.name: enabled_git_access_protocol
parameters.description: all means SSH and HTTP(S) is enabled. ssh means only SSH is enabled. http means only HTTP(S) is enabled. Only available for top level groups. Choices: "all" "ssh" "http"

parameters.name: force_delete
parameters.description: Force delete group even if projects in it. Used only when state=absent. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: lfs_enabled
parameters.description: Projects in this group can use Git LFS. Choices: false true

parameters.name: lock_duo_features_enabled
parameters.description: Enforce GitLab Duo features for all subgroups. Only available for top level groups. Choices: false true

parameters.name: membership_lock
parameters.description: Users cannot be added to projects in this group. Choices: false true

parameters.name: mentions_disabled
parameters.description: Group mentions are disabled. Choices: false true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the group you want to create.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Allow to create subgroups. ID or Full path of parent group in the form of group/name.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path of the group you want to create, this is api_url/path. If not supplied, name is used.

parameters.name: prevent_forking_outside_group
parameters.description: Prevent forking outside of the group. Choices: false true

parameters.name: prevent_sharing_groups_outside_hierarchy
parameters.description: Members cannot invite groups outside of this group and its subgroups. Only available for top level groups. Choices: false true

parameters.name: project_creation_level
parameters.description: Determine if developers can create projects in the group. Choices: "developer" "maintainer" "noone"

parameters.name: request_access_enabled
parameters.description: Users can request access (if visibility is public or internal). Choices: false true

parameters.name: require_two_factor_authentication
parameters.description: Require all users in this group to setup two-factor authentication. Choices: false true

parameters.name: service_access_tokens_expiration_enforced
parameters.description: Service account token expiration. Changes do not affect existing token expiration dates. Only available for top level groups. Choices: false true

parameters.name: share_with_group_lock
parameters.description: Projects cannot be shared with other groups. Choices: false true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create or delete group. Possible values are present and absent. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: subgroup_creation_level
parameters.description: Allowed to create subgroups. Choices: "maintainer" "owner"

parameters.name: two_factor_grace_period
parameters.description: Delay 2FA enforcement (hours).

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Default visibility of the group. Choices: "private" ← (default) "internal" "public"

parameters.name: wiki_access_level
parameters.description: enabled means everyone can access the wiki. private means only members of this group can access the wiki. disabled means group-level wiki is disabled. Choices: "enabled" "private" "disabled"

examples:
- name: "Delete GitLab Group"
  community.general.gitlab_group:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    name: my_first_group
    state: absent

- name: "Create GitLab Group"
  community.general.gitlab_group:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    validate_certs: true
    api_username: dj-wasabi
    api_password: "MySecretPassword"
    name: my_first_group
    path: my_first_group
    state: present

# The group will by created at https://gitlab.dj-wasabi.local/super_parent/parent/my_first_group
- name: "Create GitLab SubGroup"
  community.general.gitlab_group:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    validate_certs: true
    api_username: dj-wasabi
    api_password: "MySecretPassword"
    name: my_first_group
    path: my_first_group
    state: present
    parent: "super_parent/parent"

# Other group which only allows sub-groups - no projects
- name: "Create GitLab Group for SubGroups only"
  community.general.gitlab_group:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    validate_certs: true
    api_username: dj-wasabi
    api_password: "MySecretPassword"
    name: my_main_group
    path: my_main_group
    state: present
    project_creation_level: noone
    auto_devops_enabled: false
    subgroup_creation_level: maintainer

return_values.name: error
return_values.description: The error message returned by the GitLab API. Returned: failed Sample: "400: path is already in use"

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Success or failure message. Returned: always Sample: "Success"

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: JSON-parsed response from the server. Returned: always
